newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end shade lower in slack turnover.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end shade lower in slack turnover.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed slightly lower in thin trade with airline LanChile and supermarket chain D&S, both of which are planning to launch on Wall Street, among leading gainers, said dealers.
The bolsa is seen resuming its downward tilt at the opening as stocks continue to cool from the recent rally.
"Tomorrow this trend will continue. I don't see any reason for a change," said one broker.
The 40-share index closed down 0.05 percent at 131.56 points. The general index lost 0.07 percent to 5,726.65 points.
Volume slumped to eight billion pesos from 10.2 billion pesos Friday with institutional investors continuing to stay clear of the market.
Traders said the market was concerned that July inflation may be higher than expected because of rises in vegetable prices after the recent floods.
The Santiago Chamber of Commerce said Monday that consumer prices may rise 0.4-0.6 percent in July compared with 0.3 percent in July last year.
Chilean-issued American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) closed mixed, reflecting Wall Street's volatility before the Federal Reserve's policy meeting Tuesday and Wednesday.
Airline LanChile climbed four percent to 1,300 pesos on news Monday that the company is contemplating issuing ADRs, said brokers.

D&S, which announced last week it would launch on Wall Street, rallied although brokers were sceptical about the level of demand among investors for the company -- the third Chilean supermarket group to issue ADRs.
"The stock is already expensive. The sector is highly competitive and so there may not be much interest in the shares," said one broker.
D&S, one of the bourse's top gainers this year, closed up 3.63 percent to 442.5 pesos.

Losers included Banco Edwards, down 2.8 percent at 52 pesos, telecom CTC, down 2.37 percent at 3,300 pesos, and pension fund manager Provida, which shed 1.12 percent to 8,800 pesos. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
